title: AEW event spool line
description: M4-E plan v3 §2.8; amendment 1, E7a (m9): one line of .aew/local/events/<writer>.jsonl, appended by the process that saw the event and read by the operator endpoint's watcher, which notifies the operator. A line is untrusted data: the reader validates it against the definition of its writer's kind, named by the file and never by the line (`run` for a run's supervisor, `broker` for the Lead broker), drops and counts what fails, caps and cleans every string, and labels the notification `authenticated: false`. Each kind's event enum is closed: a new event is a schema change.

run.description: A run's supervisor (writer `run-<run id>`): the supervisor's deadline stop, and a launch failure recorded at its three failure sites (custody refused, the start failed, and main's records made before any supervisor exists). `subject` is the run itself. A `launch_failed` line carries its closed `reason_code` (M4-E E8b).

reason_code.description: M4-E E8b: a launch failure's closed code (`aew.harness.contract.LAUNCH_FAILURE_CODES`), carried to the notification. Telemetry: relaunch eligibility never reads a spool line.

broker.description: The Lead broker (writer `broker`): its steering loop's stops that need attention, `loop_stopped` (M4-E E7b), with the stop's code and message as `reason`, the subject it stopped on (or `project`) and the loop activation as `ref`. M4-E E7c adds `confirmation_pending`.
